name: Abyssal Signets
label: Quest
description: Abyssal Signets: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Progress
paras: You've shown you're more than capable of taking on an Abyssal Duke, friend. I'm always one to promote good habits. Bring me more signets and I'll give you a reward.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Excellent, friend! Defeating those Dukes will leave the Twilight's Hammer reeling for a while. As promised, here's your reward. It's some of the better stuff Huum and I have found.
